name: charmap-copy-first
description: Character Map: bring the dialog up if needed, then Select the default glyph into the copy field.
notes: Composed: the steps live in the charmap-select sub-recipe; this file owns the launch, the target and the exact way it may be brought up. Launches only when no charmap window is up (launch_if_missing), so replaying does not pile up instances on the same coordinates. %SystemRoot% rather than a hardcoded drive keeps it valid on any Windows install. Cheap background smoke test: no foreground activation, works while the window is minimized.
